subject.title: fix(channels): prevent outbound echoes and expose native login

question: Should OpenClaw publish the new `channel-outbound` outbound-echo registry as a supported plugin-SDK contract, rather than retaining the behavior as a Discord-owned implementation detail?
rationale: This is a new shared plugin API with compatibility and ownership consequences; the code can be repaired mechanically, but only maintainers can choose the permanent public boundary.

options.title: Adopt the shared SDK seam
options.body: Keep the generic registry, repair the turn-result types and release-note scope, then document and prove the contract across the affected transports.

options.title: Keep echo suppression Discord-owned
options.body: Remove the new public SDK exports and implement the bounded identity handling inside the Discord plugin if no cross-plugin contract is desired.

recommendation.title: Adopt the shared SDK seam
recommendation.body: Keep the generic registry, repair the turn-result types and release-note scope, then document and prove the contract across the affected transports.

likelyOwner.reason: The proposed shared channel and plugin-SDK boundary is concentrated in this contributor's current six-commit implementation, though current-main ownership evidence remains incomplete.
